description: Workflow profiles. Select exactly one per task. Steps are operating guidance, not runtime sequencing; every step still obeys actors, modes, boundaries, and evidence.

entries.use_for: Analysis, audits, design review, questions, and any task that produces findings instead of changes.
steps: resolve kernel
gather live evidence
analyze
report findings with evidence references
resolve kernel and execution mode
read the issue scope and source basis live
branch preflight
create or switch to the scoped work branch (work/<issue>-<slug>)
implement only inside scope
run validation
commit and push only if the mode allows
open a draft PR only if the mode allows
report with the execution report contract

entries.use_for: Reviewing finished work before the PM merges or closes.
steps: read the PR diff and linked issue live
check scope, validation evidence, risks, and boundaries
report a verdict with findings
leave merge and closure to the PM

entries.use_for: Turning PM input into well-formed draft issues or decision requests. No writes.
steps: gather source basis live
draft issues using the issue template
surface decisions the PM must make
deliver drafts and copy-safe command bundles only

entries.use_for: Assessing whether work is ready to release or tag. Tags and releases themselves need separate PM approval.
steps: gather merged evidence, validation evidence, and open risks live
report readiness with gaps named
stop before any tag or release action

entries.use_for: Ending a session or moving work to another agent or surface without losing state.
steps: ensure all transferable state is on GitHub (issue comments, PR state, closure evidence)
produce a handoff packet pointing to live evidence, never duplicating it as durable truth

entries.use_for: Bootstrapping a target project onto this kernel.
steps: read the target repository state and existing adapters live
draft the target AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md from adapters/ templates
keep target product truth in the target; the kernel owns only generic operating behavior
deliver the adapter diff and adoption checklist; target writes follow the target's own scoped approval
